title: Fix three bugs in a Go math utilities package
description: Fix bugs in mathutil: Max returns wrong value when b>a, Abs negates positive numbers, IsPrime returns true for n==1.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in mathutil.go:
1. Max: swap the return values — `if a >= b { return a }; return b`
2. Abs: change `if n > 0 { return -n }` to `if n > 0 { return n }`
3. IsPrime: change `if n < 2 { return true }` to `if n < 2 { return false }`
All 3 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
